title: New sign-in security alert
description: Alert users to a new device or location sign-in on WhatsApp with a button to secure their account. Utility security template.
notes: Include device, city and time. Never include links that ask for a password.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we noticed a new sign-in to your Lumen account from *{{device}}* in {{city}} on {{time}}. If this was you, no action is needed.
